title: Cross-Org 12-Week Commitments + Risk Signals
content:
Purpose
This is a lightweight, cross-organizational 12-week commitments ledger paired with a simple signal dashboard and escalation map. Goal is to create a single artifact teams can point to during weekly syncs, exec check-ins, and the March all-staff. This is not the final OKR doc — it is a living intake and risk surface for the next 3 months.

High-level intent
- Tighten focus: pick top 3 cross-company outcomes for the 12-week window that materially improve our product reliability, developer adoption, or unit economics.
- Make risks visible early: each commitment has 1–2 leading signals and an owner for rapid escalation.
- Quick comms: prepare a 7-minute all-staff segment + follow-up FAQ so teams know where to land questions.

Proposed outcomes (candidate objectives)
1) Increase production token throughput efficiency (reduce per-token cost by ~12% via batching + quantization ops)
   - Key signals: average tokens/sec per GPU, % requests using cache, 95th pct latency delta week-over-week
   - Owner: Marco Reyes (serving-runtime)
2) Reduce end-user latency spikes for hosted API routes (target: 99th pct latency <= 2x baseline)
   - Key signals: P99 per-route, count of fallback events, incidents causing >=1% error rate
   - Owner: Jordan Kim (platform-engineering)
3) Improve onboarding-to-prod time for Dedicated customers (target: commit-to-ready <= 10 days for new bookings)
   - Key signals: mean days between contract and staging ready, blocked tickets over 3 days, infra provisioning failures
   - Owner: Elena Novak (customer-success)

Minimal success criteria
- Each objective has 2 OKR-style KRs (measured, owner assigned), weekly progress snapshot, and an actionable mitigation if a leading signal crosses threshold.
- At least one cross-team working session scheduled in week 1 and week 6.
- All-staff segment prepared and rehearsed; slide + 1-pager posted to Confluence before the all-hands.

Signal dashboard (starter thresholds)
- Latency: P99 > 2x baseline for 2 consecutive days -> Tier 1 alert (exec notif)
- Throughput: avg tokens/sec per GPU drops > 15% week-over-week -> Tier 2 alert (platform on-call)
- Onboarding: > 25% of new Dedicated customers exceed 10 days -> Tier 2 escalation to Solutions Eng

Escalation map (rapid)
1) Owner observes breached signal -> immediate Slack post to #ops-incident + brief triage call (10m)
2) If unresolved in 24h or customer impact > minor -> notify Exec Sponsor (Aisha) and schedule 30m cross-org sync
3) Post-mortem decisions: rollback policies, quick patching, and comms to affected customers within 48h

All-staff segment plan (7 minutes)
- 0:00–0:45: Why we chose these 3 outcomes (1 slide, crisp problem statement)
- 0:45–3:00: What success looks like with the signal dashboard visual (2 slides)
- 3:00–5:00: Quick wins teams can ship in the next 2 weeks (bullet list + owners)
- 5:00–7:00: Where to find the ledger, how to surface blockers, and call-to-action (contribs welcome)

Weekly cadence
- Monday async update: each owner posts a 3-line snapshot to the ledger doc + the channel (#12w-commitments)
- Wednesday 30m working sync (solution deep-dives as needed)
- Friday optional office hours for unblockers (rotating hosts)

Open questions / notes to self
- Do we want to require a QA gating checklist for any changes touching caching logic? (Samir raised this)
- Should we add a secondary metric for developer experience (time-to-first-successful-request)?
- Need slides + one-pager by week 0.5 (assign copy & design).

Immediate asks for execs (for the all-staff and launch week)
- Exec Sponsor confirmation for each objective (just a name + 30m monthly check-in)
- Priority lane for infra quota bump if we pilot a larger Dedicated onboarding run in week 3
- Quick review of the comms script prior to rehearsal (Aisha will ping)

Appendix (links & artifacts)
- Draft ledger (this doc) -> Confluence page: CONFLUENCE-1234
- Working tickets: JIRA-OPS-678 (throughput), JIRA-ENG-910 (latency investigations)
- Slack channel: #12w-commitments

Next steps (week 0)
- Owners accept / refine KRs in this document by Friday EOD -> assign any missing JIRA tickets
- Schedule the week 1 cross-team working session (owners + SRE + Solutions Eng)
- Build the simple dashboard (initial metrics in Grafana) and wire the alerting thresholds

Bottom line: this is intended to be a pragmatic, low-friction mechanism to align across teams for the next 12 weeks, make risks visible fast, and ensure our all-staff communicates progress rather than ambiguity. Treat this as draft — please add notes inline and flag anything that feels like scope creep.
